{{Quote|The seven worlds have united in a glorious alliance for greater prosperity and military strength.|Empress Teta|<ref name="TGAotS1">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 1]]</ref>}}
The '''Unification Wars''', also known as the '''Reunification Wars''', were fought in the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Koros system]] in an attempt to unify all seven worlds, led by Empress [[Teta/Legends|Teta]].<ref name="TGAotS0" />

The Teta aristocrats had granted mining control in the system by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Fattum]], however the spoiled nobles decided to ignore [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]]. Teta ascended in [[5010 BBY]] and begun the Wars to crush illegal mining settlements, sometimes using shocking brutality. Coruscantis hailed the Wars as a return of law and order,<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> however some factions such as the [[Kirrek rebels]], posed a military resistance to Teta's dreams.<ref name="TGAotS0" />

The last battle of the Unification Wars was the [[Battle of Kirrek (Unification Wars)|Battle of Kirrek]] which marked Teta's victory.<ref name="TGAotS0" />

Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Unification Day]] was celebrated in memory of the Unification Wars.<ref name="Unification Day">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Events&message.id=4|text=Unification Day Celebration on July 4th}}</ref>
